description: Current ISO 3166-2 subdivisions that Natural Earth v5.1.2 carries under another code, or only as the subdivisions they are made of. build-geometry.mjs composes each shape from the Natural Earth features named in `from` (iso_3166_2 codes as Natural Earth writes them), or from every feature of the country whose property matches `where`. Each row names the change or the parent relation it rests on.
